surface_mechanism_description: At 160 /C14 C, the functionality of the surface is observed to switch between iPrCp and OH groups. Additionally, bands attributed to carbonates are observed to appear during cycling, but not during the purge steps. This indicates the carbonate-forming reaction is not related to reactions involving the surface-bound iPrCp ligands. At 350 /C14 C, in contrast, the extended precursor pulses yield clear evidence of thermal decomposition.
